question.value: Molecular inventories, physical properties, evolutionary stages, and possible chemical links in G336.99-00.03 MM1 and MM2.

evidence.quote: Herein, we report molecular inventories of two millimeter continuum sources in G336.99-00.03 that are at different stages of evolution.
providing an opportunity to examine the physical and chemical properties — such as temperature, density, and evolutionary stage — of its millimeter continuum sources.

G336.99-00.03 (IRAS 16318-4724) is one of the targets of the ATOMS (Project ID: 2019.1.00685.S; PI: Tie Liu), which targeted 146 bright infrared IRAS sources exhibiting bright CS (J = 2–1) emission (cite: Liu20).
In this study, a line survey was conducted towards the high-mass star forming region G336.99-00.03 using the ALMA interferometer at Band 3, covering a frequency range of 97.5–101.4 GHz.
Continuum images were generated from line-free channels in SPWs 7 and 8, centred at $\sim$99.4 GHz.
